web.description:
# API Portal: Open & Licensed Data Resources
## Business, Finance & Macroeconomics
- [FRED](https://fred.stlouisfed.org/) – Economic data from the Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis, including interest rates, GDP, and inflation.
  - [FRED API documentation](https://fred.stlouisfed.org/docs/api/fred/)
- [World Bank](https://www.worldbank.org/ext/en/home) – Global development and economic indicators for countries worldwide.
  - [World Bank API documentation](https://documents.worldbank.org/en/publication/documents-reports/api)
- [OECD](https://www.oecd.org/en.html) – Economic, social, and financial statistics from 38 member countries.
  - [OECD API documentation](https://www.oecd.org/en/data/insights/data-explainers/2024/09/api.html)
- [European Central Bank](https://www.ecb.europa.eu/home/html/index.en.html) – Monetary statistics, interest rates, and economic research for the eurozone.
  - [ECB API documentation](https://data.ecb.europa.eu/help/api/overview)

web.title: Data Download Program and Federal Reserve Economic Data Partnership
web.description:
## Data Download Program and Federal Reserve Economic Data Partnership
##### Related Information
[DDP in FRED](https://fred.stlouisfed.org/collection/federal-reserve-board-data)

#### Improved Charting Feature on Federal Reserve Economic Data (FRED) Website
Louis’s [Federal Reserve Economic Data (FRED)](https://fred.stlouisfed.org/collection/federal-reserve-board-data).

#### New Version of Application Programming Interface for All FRED and DDP Series Available
**November 4, 2025**

- FRED’s [API Version 2](https://fred.stlouisfed.org/docs/api/fred/v2/index.html) allows account holders to retrieve observations for all FRED and DDP series in any release in bulk and obtain the entire history in JSON or XML format.

#### Data Download Program and Federal Reserve Economic Data Partnership
All releases available through the DDP are now accessible within the FRED database.

FRED offers more than 300 macroeconomic-related data releases from a variety of source providers, including Board data currently offered through the DDP. FRED launched in 1991 and continues to expand its data offerings to researchers, students, business professionals, and others with an interest in economic data.
